newsitem.title: USA: Enova, PET send FERC back-up merger filing.
newsitem.headline: Enova, PET send FERC back-up merger filing.

text.p: Enova Corp and Pacific Enterprises submitted a back-up filing to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission requesting review of their planned merger, the companies said Tuesday.
Enova, parent of San Diego Gas and Electric Co, and Pacific Enterprises, parent of Southern California Gas Co, filed in December for exemption from FERC review.
The companies still insist that FERC does not have jurisdiction over the merger of an electric utility with a gas utility, but made a second filing as a back-up measure.
"This is a parellel track. If for some reason FERC decides it does have jurisdiction we want to make sure the process is underway," Doug Kline, a spokesman for Enova, said.
The companies are asking FERC for a 150-day decision period if the federal agency decides it does have jurisdiction.
